title: Pooling - 2ml Tuberack to 2ml Tuberack
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Specify pooling worklist
steps.instruction:
Enter the custom pooling worklist in the exact format shown below:
```
Number 8 pos TB_RCK_1,pos MTP_1,transfer_vol TUBE BAR 1,TUBE BAR 1
1,1,200
2,35,200
3,2,150
4,90,100
5,84
6,62
7,42
8,18
...
```

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package to your computer and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required labware JSON files (if any).

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol script file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck of the robot according to the provided deck map for this protocol.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette as described in the app’s calibration workflow (refer to support articles if needed).

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to execute the custom pooling protocol.
